articles.title: K/DA Reactivates Social Accounts, Fueling Rumors of the Virtual K-pop Group’s Comeback After 6 Years
articles.summary: Official K/DA accounts have been updated for the first time in six years. New profile and banner images continue to show the existing promotional art from the All Out era, now with the addition of hot pink flames.
body: K/DA, which debuted at the 2018 League of Legends World Championship, consists of four League champions (Ahri, Akali, Evelynn, and Kai'Sa) voiced by international pop-stars. The group’s first single, aptly called POP/STARS, was the first K-pop song by a girl group to receive RIAA Platinum certification in 2022. The early success of the girl group prompted the release of a full EP, All Out, in 2020.
Since then, the group has pretty much gone dark. K/DA skins still exist in-game, but there’s been no word on new music or performances. Until now.

An updated banner image continues to use promotional images from the All Out era, showing the main K/DA quartet alongside the era’s guest artist, Seraphine, who was a newly released champion at the time. As of October 13, however, those images also show the addition of hot pink and magenta flames.

Data-mined leaks from earlier this year already raised hopes that the group would have some role in the current season of League of Legends. Details in a Wild Rift update, first spotted by SkinSpotlights, pointed to a potential “Firestarter” skin concept, as well as a new song registered on the ASCAP Repertory.

articles.title: Hideo Kojima Reviews The Resident Evil Movie
articles.summary: Writer-director Hideo Kojima has seen Zach Cregger's Resident Evil movie, and he has now shared his review. Kojima, a true cinephile known for his public movie reviews, said he "wasn't particularly interested" in seeing the movie at first, but he did, and he sounded pretty impressed by what he saw.
body: "Right from the opening, it hits you with music reminiscent of The Thing. From there, it’s a relentless barrage of classic horror techniques, terrifying situations, and jump scares that never lets up until the very end," he said.

Kojima went on to observe what others did as well, which is how the Resident Evil movie is more of a film that provides the "experience of playing Resident Evil" as opposed to watching an adaptation of one of its stories.

"It reminded me of how I felt when I first played the original Resident Evil on PlayStation back in 1996," he said. "I was just like [main character] Bryan in this movie. I kept getting game over after game over, shouting “F***!” over and over again. lol."

This is the kind of response that Cregger said he wanted viewers to have. It's also what got Cregger in some hot water with hardcore fans who wanted to see a straight adaptation of one of the games instead of Cregger's own original story set inside the world of Resident Evil.
points: Writer-director Hideo Kojima has seen Zach Cregger's Resident Evil movie, and he has now shared his review.

articles.title: Battlefield 6 Now Lets You Instantly Unlock All Guns At 100% Mastery For $30
articles.summary: It's a big week for Battlefield 6, as the game just launched its big Season 5 update, arrived on Xbox Game Pass, and ushered in a new Game of the Year Edition. That's not all, however, as the military shooter added a big new microtransaction in the form of the Ultimate Shortcut Kit.
body: Similar to how these shortcut kits worked in past Battlefield games, Battlefield 6's $30 no-so-microtransaction instantly unlocks all of the game's guns for all four classes, and at 100% Mastery--this means they are fully leveled up and kitted out.

People online have raised concerns about the existence of the Ultimate Shortcut Kit, saying it's unfair to allow people to buy every gun right from the start instead of grinding to progress. Other people said they welcome the Ultimate Shortcut Kit because they do not have the time or the interest in spending countless hours levelling up their guns and just want to play everything the game has to offer.

In addition to all the guns, the Ultimate Shortcut Kit for Battlefield 6 includes the Mortal Shriek dog tag and the Field Training: Cross Trained title. Below is a rundown of everything you get in the Ultimate Shortcut Kit.
Similar Ultimate Shortcut Kits for Battlefield 3 ($40) and Battlefield 4 ($50) cost more.

articles.title: Officially Licensed Fallout Bookends Are Up for Preorder for a Whopping $325
articles.summary: The Fallout series is one of the most popular video game franchises of all time. Naturally, that means there's a ton of Fallout merch. Like any product tied to a specific IP, you can always expect some sort of markup on officially licensed products.
body: While $325 isn't unheard of for a hand-painted collectible figure, it does seem like an excessive price to pay for a set of bookends. Just to put it in perspective, you can currently get a semi-functional Pip-Boy replica from the IGN Store for only $300. Dark Horse also recently launched, in my opinion, a much cooler set of Fallout bookends for only $179.99.

So what exactly is making these bookends so expensive? In addition to the licensing fee to collaborate with Bethesda on the product, these bookends apparently weigh four pounds each. They're "meticulously sculpted from polyresin" and individually hand-painted to achieve the antique metal effects the Fallout series is known for.

The official Fallout bookends are available to preorder now with an estimated shipping window of November 2026 - January 2027. According to Sideshow's shipping policy, the company does offer 30 days for returns if you aren't happy with your purchase once you get your hands on it.

Like any product tied to a specific IP, you can always expect some sort of markup on officially licensed products.

articles.title: Xbox Announces Xbox Labs, Aimed in Part at Getting Improved Old-Gen Games Playable in Web Browsers
articles.summary: Xbox has announced Xbox Labs, a new initiative aimed at getting games to more people in more places — with a particular emphasis on web browsers.
body: No doubt seeing the growing community of games getting improved versions ported into web browsers (like the 94fps browser version of Halo: Combat Evolved), Microsoft itself is keen to get in on the action in support of new Xbox CEO Asha Sharma's goal of reaching 1 billion players per day.

Xbox has been tinkering with running Xbox and Xbox 360 games in browsers, and the Xbox Labs initiative is a formalization of those efforts that will see a small team of engineers playing with emerging technologies in order to find new ways for games new and old to be distributed and even created. And IGN understands that this won't just be an R&D effort; rather, Xbox Labs is tasked with shipping products – Sharma says, "We'll build in the open" – and getting gamers to engage with them.

articles.title: Despite Huge Changes For The Series, Halo Fest 2026 Is Going Forward, And News Is Coming Soon
articles.summary: The big Halo Fest event planned for December is going ahead as planned, despite mass layoffs and other major changes at developer Halo Studios. Halo Studios director of competitive engagement, Tashi, confirmed this and said there will be news about Halo Fest this week.
body: "There's a huge amount of Halo fans who are looking forward to the event to attend or watch from home, and we're looking forward to providing a platform for the community to celebrate 25 years of Halo and each other," Tashi said of Halo Fest.

Halo Fest takes place December 11-13 in Seattle--the event is totally sold out. "No matter why you love Halo, whether it’s the story and characters, the music, the art and universe, or just playing with friends--Halo Fest will have something for you," Microsoft said of the event.

The voices of Master Chief and Cortana, Steve Downes and Jen Taylor, will appear at Halo Fest, while there will also be a range of community events celebrating the series. Some had expected Halo Studios to announce the next big Halo game at Halo Fest, but it's not unreasonable to think that plans may have changed.

articles.title: The Best Street Fighter Anime You've Never Seen
articles.summary: The latest Street Fighter movie is hurricane-kicking its way into theaters on October 16 — but did you know there was a critically acclaimed animated film that came out decades before it?
body: Street Fighter II: The Animated Movie came out in 1994, the same year that the so-bad-it's-good live-action film with Jean-Claude Van Damme and Raul Julia was released. And while the highly-quotable (“For me, it was Tuesday”) live-action flick is a larger part of the public consciousness, most Street Fighter fans will agree that the animated movie blows it out of the water.

The animated movie doesn’t follow the World Warrior tournament seen in the game; instead, it focuses on Bison tracking down strong warriors using an army of cyborgs in an attempt to capture them for his own nefarious purposes. It’s not an official part of the official Street Fighter lore (which, admittedly, is quite confusing and convoluted), but it features some fantastic fights and, of course, the debut of Violent Ken (an evil version of the character corrupted by M. Bison's Psycho Power).

articles.title: Red Dead’s Shocking Twist Ending Angered A Lot Of People, But It Was The Right Call, Rockstar Co-Founder Says
articles.summary: Rockstar co-founder Dan Houser has recalled the controversial ending to 2010's Red Dead Redemption in which the main character, John Marston, is killed. He said in an interview that the game's lead designer, Christian Cantamessa was on board with the idea to kill off Marston, but Houser wondered…
body: "So I said, ‘I think maybe we have to kill him.’ And he goes, ‘That's a great idea. Got to do it.’ I said, ‘I don't know if… let me just think about this,’ because we're just dealing with audio and dialogue," Houser told IGN "The nature of an open-world game is you finish a story, then you go back into the world and wrap up all the side content if you want to. We'd have to play as someone else for that. We could play as Jack, but what does that mean? So I had to think through for a while what it would mean production-wise.”

How Rockstar handled it was by setting RDR's epilogue years later, in the year 1914, with players taking control of Marston's son, Jack. He said this setup presented challenges, too, in terms of the technical realities of playing as Jack as opposed to John. There were story and mission concerns, too, including how multi-stage missions might play out if players, as John, completed one part and then came back to finish later as Jack.
"How would that work? We had to think through all of that stuff and concluded we could probably make it work, but we were still scared," he said.

articles.title: 63 Years Later, the Best 'Peanuts' Sally Line Is Still an Iconic Comic Strip Quote
articles.summary: In almost 50 years, however, despite taking more Ls than a stuck typewriter, Charlie Brown almost never actually got mad about it. His style is more of a world-weary acceptance, verging on Zen calm. It's left to other characters to rage, cry, and question their lot.
body: Charlie Brown is one of the most consistently unlucky characters in Western fiction. The degree to which life and the universe conspire to dump misfortune directly on his head is the beating heart of Charles Schulz's Peanuts. If you've got any problems at all, you can see what Charlie Brown's up to and be slightly cheered up by the knowledge that at least you've got it better than him.

When modern fans talk about Peanuts, all of Sally's best-remembered moments usually have to do with either her constant innocent windmill dunks on Charlie Brown or her deeply one-sided crush on Linus. On a reread, however, what really stood out about Sally is her antagonistic relationship with academia.

Sally is Peanuts' patron saint of unwilling students. Most of the rest of the Peanuts gang never seemed to mind their studies. ( Patty isn't good at school, but she didn't actively resent it the way that Sally does.) If you were one of those kids who did their level best to try to wriggle out from under the burden of public schooling, Sally was your representation in the Peanuts crew.
points: In almost 50 years, however, despite taking more Ls than a stuck typewriter, Charlie Brown almost never actually got mad about it.
His style is more of a world-weary acceptance, verging on Zen calm.
It's left to other characters to rage, cry, and question their lot.

articles.title: Dropout Announces New Scripted Series that Spoofs MTV
articles.summary: Dropout announced a new series on Tuesday. Unlike most of the streamer's improv-heavy shows, the three-episode MP3 is a live-action scripted series.
body: Starring Saturday Night Live standout Jeremy Culhane, Skye Townsend, Aparna Nancherla, and Paul F. Tompkins, MP3 will spoof music video countdown shows, like MTV's Total Request Live. Each episode, Culhane, Townsend, and Nancherla's host characters will present music videos, interview guests, and argue with their producer, played by Tompkins.

Dropout favorites like Katie Marovitch, Lou Wilson, and Jacob Wysocki will appear as artists in the music videos. Jess McKenna and Zach Reino also play producers, and even appear in some of the music videos. They're also writers on the show and in charge of the music compositions. Very Important People fans will recognize Anna Garcia's Princess Emily making an appearance in the trailer, making us wonder if any other characters from across the Dropout network will cameo.

MP3 will stream its first episode Wednesday, Nov. 4. Like most other Dropout series, it will debut new episodes every two weeks, so keep Nov. 18 and Dec. 2 clear on your calendar. As the focus of the show is on music, each song performed on MP3 will be released on music streaming services after new episodes air.

articles.title: CD Projekt Red reassures players The Witcher 3 Switch 2 patch still due, as update rolls out for PS5 and PS5 Pro
articles.summary: CD Projekt Red has released an update for The Witcher 3 Remastered on PlayStation 5 and PS5 Pro, making "various stability improvements to help ensure a more reliable experience" to the game. And those are the entire patch notes for hotfix 5.01b, Eurogamer understands.
body: The update has drawn some concern from players waiting for the promised Switch 2 Witcher 3 update, prompting the studio to reassure people on X that: "We're working on getting the Nintendo Switch 2 patch to all users as soon as possible." That Switch 2 patch is said to improve visual "clarity and sharpness" in the game.

CD Projekt Red has been busy addressing issues with the Remastered edition of The Witcher 3 since it was released two weeks ago. It's a transformative update, significantly altering the game's visuals while also changing animations, skills, and even some gameplay. Given its breadth - and that it's free and occurring 11 years after the game's release - I called The Witcher 3 Remastered an extraordinarily generous upgrade after playing it, though the game's audience isn't entirely happy. Some feel it made the game too bright, though this aspect has been addressed in patches since release.

articles.title: Netflix Releases Official First Trailer for Greta Gerwig's Narnia Movie
articles.summary: Netflix has released the first trailer for Narnia: The Magician's Nephew, Barbie and Little Women director Greta Gerwig's adaptation of C.S. Lewis' novel, giving fantasy fans their first look at next year's highly anticipated film.
body: In fact, viewers get a look at the very creation of Lewis' universe (and the book series' famous wardrobe) in the first spectacular trailer for Narnia: The Magician's Nephew.

Netflix's first trailer for its Narnia movie shows protagonists Digory Kirke (David McKenna) and Polly Plummer (Beatrice Campbell) experiencing worlds beyond their own, courtesy of the "magician" Andrew Ketterley (Daniel Craig) — "infinity worlds" filled with light and dark magic. The trailer certainly lives up to the magical, musical aesthetic that Gerwig said she was going for.

Narnia: The Magician’s Nephew will serve as the first live-action film adaptation of Lewis' book. Other installments in the seven-book Narnia series have been adapted multiple times, particularly The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe. Live-action adaptations of Prince Caspian and The Voyage of the Dawn Treader have also been released. The Magician’s Nephew was previously adapted for the theater, radio, and in comic form. Netflix acquired the rights to C.S. Lewis' works in 2018.

articles.title: Xbox Is Experimenting with a Controversial Social Media Feature
articles.summary: Do you like it when software utilizes subtle forms of psychological manipulation to keep you coming back? If so, you will be thrilled to hear that Xbox is experimenting with a new streak feature that will highlight how many weeks in a row you’ve actively used your console.
body: Totilo shared an image of his Xbox profile showing a UI indicator with a checkmark for each day he signed on this past week and an empty circle for the days he didn’t (or that haven’t happened yet). Playing Xbox at least three days in a week starts or continues a streak. Those with a streak have a flame symbol next to this UI element, along with a number showing how many weeks in a row they’ve maintained it.

Beyond the profile menu, the streak appears more prominently in the top-left corner of the Xbox dashboard, with an indicator of how many consecutive weeks you’ve kept your streak going and how close you are to continuing it this week.

Streak systems are common across tech platforms because they incentivize users to keep coming back through gamification — thanks to something deep in our lizard brains, it’s satisfying to watch numbers go up (in this case, a streak indicator). Streak features have been used by Snapchat, Wordle, and many others, and while relatively innocuous when used for health apps or learning tools like Duolingo, they come across as far more manipulative in other contexts.
points: Do you like it when software utilizes subtle forms of psychological manipulation to keep you coming back?
If so, you will be thrilled to hear that Xbox is experimenting with a new streak feature that will highlight how many weeks in a row you’ve actively used your console.

articles.title: World of Warcraft: Forever won't destroy what made the old classes so satisfying by modernizing them into oblivion: 'The level of mechanical complexity found in the beta classes is indicative of our intentions'
articles.summary: Part of World of Warcraft: Forever's charm is that combat is considerably slower than the regular version of the MMO. It's the kind of game where you'll spend 38 seconds hitting a scorpion because there are so few buttons to press in the early stages of your journey.
body: Classes in WoW's past were simple, but had small quirks to them that you'd pick up over time. Melee classes, for example, can squeeze abilities in between their auto attacks to maximize their damage output. You'd never care about this if fights only took 10 seconds, like they do in WoW today, but back then you had to use all that time in more drawn-out battles for something.

The WoW: Forever beta has reminded me how satisfying it is to play a class that isn't built like Whac-A-Mole, where the challenge is to hit the right buttons the moment they start to glow. There's a rhythm to WoW's old classes and I'm delighted to hear that Blizzard fully intends to maintain it in WoW: Forever.

Blizzard developers told TechRadar that they want "to err on the side of simpler classes, but with engaging depth," and that all of it will align with its guiding principle of staying true to the old MMO's "core design, pacing, and tone."
"The level of mechanical complexity found in the beta classes is indicative of our intentions," Blizzard says.

articles.title: "That was not received well at Nintendo" - as GTA 6 and Zelda are lampooned by Saturday Night Live, former employees recall Elon Musk Wario skit controversy
articles.summary: As American comedy series Saturday Night Live airs a sketch lampooning the November showdown between Grand Theft Auto 6 and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, a pair of former Nintendo employees have recalled a more infamous SNL sketch from years earlier that did not go down well at all.
body: The older SNL sketch had controversial billionaire businessman Elon Musk dress as Nintendo character Wario, on trial for being evil, ironically enough. During the trial there were mentions of Mario taking drugs, blurred out Luigi dick pics, all while Wario-Musk tried to convince the courtroom he was misunderstood.

"That did not go over well," Krysta Yang said on the Kit and Krysta podcast (via Techradar ). Yang was a former host of Nintendo Minute with Kit Ellis - the eponymous Kit in the podcast's title - and both worked within Nintendo for more than 10 years.
"We were still there for that," Ellis added. "That was one that was not beloved by the people... That was not received well at Nintendo," Yang echoed..

Ellis said the Wario sketch came out of "leftfield" because it wasn't obviously tethered to anything, as there wasn't a Mario or Wario game releasing at that time. "Why is Elon Musk Wario?" Ellis recalled people wondering. "Some of the stuff was getting into subject matter that was uncomfortable for Nintendo."

videos.summary: Pre-orders for METRO 2039 are now open, and we are revealing the editions that will be available on launch day, come February 4th 2027!
body: We know many of you can’t wait to get your hands on the next METRO, and are in desperate need of a wearable Spartan Helmet replica to add to your gaming collection. Well, the day has come to secure it!

We recently revealed that Blueprints are a new feature in METRO 2039, encouraging exploration and allowing you to craft upgrades and attachments for weapons and gear. The Specialist Pack pre-order bonus, available for all pre-ordered editions, gives you the opportunity to unlock these early. There are three upgrades to choose from, but you can only equip one at a time – choose wisely!
